title: Person holding winner sign and prototype in front of InnoShow banners
objects_and_counts: One adult person is visible, standing front center, wearing a surgical-style face mask and light-coloured shirt; the person's face is partially obscured by the mask.

The person is holding a white, fish- or drone-shaped physical prototype with visible internal electronics mounted in an open compartment; the prototype is held across the person's torso with both hands.
One handheld cutout sign is visible; the sign has a multi-colour header reading WINNER and additional text and graphics beneath it and is held by the person.
Two tall vertical pull-up banners are visible behind the person: one at the left background and one at the right background.
Three lower cabinet/locker doors with perforated fronts and horizontal handles are visible along the bottom of the image; each cabinet door has a padlock or lock device attached.
One small square sticker or label is visible on the left side of the white prototype (near the person's left hand); the sticker's detailed text or logo is not legible at full resolution.
